headline: Sonos is taking up to 30 percent off speakers and soundbars right now
summary: Sonos Black Friday sale is now live. Get up to 30% off speakers and soundbars. The Arc Ultra soundbar hits a new low of $849.

headline: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
summary: Google's Gemini app for macOS now features "computer use." It can automate multi-step tasks across local files and apps. This boosts workflows, form filling, and presentations.

headline: Leaked images reveal Motorola’s wide foldable
summary: New leaked images showcase Motorola's Razr Flex. It suggests widescreen will be the default for future foldables. The phone is shown from multiple angles in two finishes.

headline: Oh, Elon Musk is ‘moderate’ now, is he?
summary: Elon Musk distanced himself from Donald Trump's movement. He claims to be "ideologically quite moderate." This contrasts with his past CPAC appearance.

headline: Escape From New York: John Carpenter 'Demanded' to Score Zack Snyder’s Remake
summary: John Carpenter will score Zack Snyder's Escape From New York remake. The original director "demanded" to be involved. Fans can be assured of his musical touch.

headline: The Acer Nitro Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC Drops to Just $1,890 for Black Friday, Excels at 4K Gaming
summary: Acer Nitro Radeon RX 9070 XT PC is $1,890 for Black Friday. It offers excellent 4K gaming performance. This deal nearly matches pricier GeForce RTX 5070 Ti.

headline: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth Review
summary: David Fincher directs "The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth." It's a sequel to "Once Upon a Time in Hollywood." Fincher deftly captures Tarantino's unique voice and tone.

headline: An Estimated 2 Million Eager Xbox Gamers Made Use of the 'New Zealand Trick' to Play GTA 6 Early
summary: 2 million Xbox gamers used the "New Zealand trick" for early GTA 6 access. Players changed console regions to play a day early. This exploit allowed them to bypass release times.

headline: Men guilty of abusing woman drugged and advertised for sex by husband
summary: Philip Young drugged and raped his wife for 13 years. Other men found guilty of abusing Joanne Young. The horrific crimes included advertising her for sex.

headline: 'You can be believed and understood': Joanne Young speaks after verdict
summary: Joanne Young speaks out after her husband's conviction. She waived anonymity to encourage other victims. Her message: "You can be believed and understood."

headline: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
summary: UN's International Court of Justice ruled Myanmar committed genocide. The verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown. Thousands of Rohingya were killed in the crackdown.

headline: Covid inquiry report: key findings on testing, tracing and 'the pingdemic'
summary: UK Covid inquiry releases key findings. Early efforts to contain coronavirus "were doomed to fail." Report details failures in testing, tracing, and the "pingdemic."
